# Wanderoo

Wanderoo is a travel planning website for curated destination packages, honeymoon trips, group travel, and custom enquiries.

## Important URLs
- Home: /
- About: /about-us
- Contact: /contact
- Dynamic sitemap: /sitemap.xml

## Dynamic Content
- Destination pages are available at /destination/{destination-slug}
- Package detail pages are available at /{destination-slug}/{package-slug}
- Package and destination content is managed from the admin panel.

## Crawling Guidance
- Use /sitemap.xml for the current list of public destination and package URLs.
- Do not use /admin/ pages as public content.
